decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Consideration has been given to the special circumstances applicable to the development including the restricted funding available for the redevelopment of the campus, the substantial inherent energy savings that would result from the provision of the new buildings, the extraordinary costs associated with the refurbishment and provision of disabled access to Spring Grove House, a Grade II Listed Building, and the major contribution the higher education institution provides to the skills level and training of residents of the Borough. 

In light of these circumstances, the use of solar thermal power as per the recommendation of the 'Initial Assessment of LZC Technologies' by Hilson Moran, dated 6 February 2008 and 'The use of low carbon technologies - Draft submission on renewables strategy for the purposes of planning consent' by Spie Matthew Hall, dated 7 November 2008, which give details of the reduction in carbon dioxide emissions from the provision of on-site renewable energy, pursuant to condition 19 of planning permission 00570/A/P16(19), are acceptable and approval is recommended subject to the additional conditions below. This would satisfactorily accord with the objectives of policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), C.2.1 (Educational Facilities) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; and policies 2A.1 (Sustainability criteria), 3A.22 (High and further education), 4A.3 (Sustainable design and construction) and 4A.7 (Renewable energy) of the London Plan (as amended).

Condition : 2 - Prior to the occupation of Building A, a technical specification and drawings providing details of the solar hot water system hereby approved, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the system shall be installed and maintained permanently thereafter in accordance with approved details.
description: Following approval for redevelopment of West Thames College to provide 14,902m2 (14,462 gross internal floor area) of education and related floorspace comprising of: Three main blocks linked by a central atrium, providing academic and vocational teaching space, administration, catering, social and ancillary uses. A revised car parking layout with 225 car parking spaces including 14 disabled spaces, 170 cycle spaces and 12 spaces for motorcycle parking. Creation of an all weather sports pitch and cricket nets. Improvements to existing access arrangements. Alterations to internal road, pedestrian and circulation routes. New replacement hard and soft landscaping. Temporary buildings totalling 1,900m2 and associated service, infrastructure, enabling and accommodation works to site, details submitted pursuant to Condition 19 (Carbon Emissions) of planning reference 00570/A/P16 dated 13/02/08
